title: Project entity: per-file editor data (curve colours, waves, undo journal) in a per-project folder (.scp.json) -- service class + API first

decisions.text: Core is a server-side service ProjectStore in MindWaveCore/server/project-store.ts (host-level infrastructure, not Gnaural-specific), following the GnauralEditorStore archetype: interface + Impl + createProjectStore factory, ProjectStoreError extends Error {status} + mapProjectStoreError, singleton wired in server.ts next to archiveStore/gnauralEditorStore. UI client lives with its consumers: GnauralCore/ui/project-api.ts + composables/use-project.ts, modelled on audio-api.ts.

Project identity: normalized absolute source path -> deterministic folder name <slug>-<hash8>. slug = sanitized basename without extension (Windows-forbidden chars -> _, ~40 chars cap); hash8 = first 8 hex of sha1(resolve(path).toLowerCase()) -- same normalization as withFileLock. project.scp.json stores source.path + fingerprint (size, mtime) for status checks and re-link. No global index: listing = scan of projects/*/project.scp.json.

REVISED owner 2026-07-15 (req 11): Project folder layout: <userDataRoot>/projects/<slug>-<hash8>/ containing project.scp.json (the main file, text, pretty JSON, req 4) and undo.json (text, separate file because it is large and written often). NO cache/ subfolder -- caches stay central (Q4), so the project folder is text-only and req 5 holds trivially. Main file name is fixed; human readability is carried by the folder name and source.path, which survives source renames.

project.scp.json schema: { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'SoundCoreProject', source, createdAt, updatedAt, sections: { <name>: opaque JSON } }. The core does not know section contents -- each section is owned by its subsystem (req 2); unknown sections are preserved on rewrite (forward compatibility). Writes are atomic (tmp+rename); reads are tolerant: a corrupt file is renamed to project.scp.json.broken-<ts>, store restarts empty, incident is logged -- never silently lost.

API-first (req 7). Phase 1 delivers the full core interface: openProject (find-or-create + folder provisioning; falls back to a source.path scan when the hash dir does not match, e.g. after relink), getProject, listProjects (scan + source status), getSection/putSection (atomic, coalesced), getUndoJournal/putUndoJournal (limits), deleteProject, relinkProject; exportProject/importProject arrive in Phase 5. No cache API (PR-D9 revised). On top: REST /api/projects* with the {error} envelope, Project* types in SharedPasCore/ts/protocol.ts, UI client project-api.ts, composable use-project.ts (reactive sections: debounce, flush on file switch). Server subsystems call ProjectStore directly (DI of the singleton).

LOCKED owner 2026-07-15 (req 8): User data folder: key user_data_root in the SQLite app_settings table, default on Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\KKSoundCore (fallback without LOCALAPPDATA: ~/.kksoundcore for non-Windows dev); projects under <root>/projects/. Editable in editor settings (req 3), validated like presetsRoot (directory must exist); changing the folder migrates projects (PR3.2).

Write discipline: client debounces ~500ms per section + immediate flush on file switch/unload; server keeps a per-project sequential write queue (withFileLock analogue). No cross-tab conflict detection: last-write-wins per section (sections are small and independent -- risk R2, accepted).

Undo journal (req 1): GTrackSchedule snapshots are already JSON-serializable (signature() = JSON.stringify), so the journal persists to undo.json with limits (~50 entries and/or ~5 MB), deferred writes (on activity pause), restore on file open. The core ships only the get/put transport (PR1.3); GTrackModel integration is PR2.2.

REVISED owner 2026-07-15 (Q4/req 11): caches stay CENTRAL (tmp/ + manifest) -- otherwise the UI may not know about them when projects live in arbitrary places. The Project entity has NO cache API and no cache/ folder; per-file caches keep using the central manifest keyed by source fingerprint (sha1(path+size+mtime+kind)). Waveform peaks cache (PR6.1) also goes to the central cache; PR6.2 (moving the render cache into projects) is DROPPED.

LOCKED owner 2026-07-15 (Q3/req 10): Import/export without zip dependencies (none exist in the workspace): export = a single text bundle <slug>.scpexport.json (schemaVersion + project.scp.json + undo.json). One portable file, stays text (req 5); caches are central and not exported. Import: schema validation, conflict with an existing project -> 409 + explicit choice, re-link to the local source path.

REVISED owner 2026-07-15 (Q2/req 9): Migration of existing per-file localStorage keys (mindwave-gtrack-lanes, mindwave-gtrack-lane-spectrum, mindwave-gtrack-mix-excluded) into project sections, one-time on first open; the localStorage copy is NOT deleted in this plan (transition safety net, risk R5). Voice colour/hidden/muted MOVE OUT of the .gnaural file into the voiceState section (step PR2.4): values imported from the file once on first open, after which the editor stops writing them to the file (the voice-state endpoint is deprecated); mute/solo reach playback and render via the XML transform mechanism of gnaural-solo-render.ts. Stale attributes in existing .gnaural files are not scrubbed -- the project is the source of truth after migration (risk R9).

Tests and verification: project-store.test.ts co-located, bun:test, mkdtemp fixture (modelled on audio-cache-manifest.test.ts). There is no CI -- each step's verify is run by hand (plan section 6); prefer driving the real app over a green typecheck.

Owner 2026-07-15 (Q5/req 12): editor defaults + project overrides pattern. The editor keeps global default settings; a project stores only its own values in its section and restores them on open; an absent section/key means the editor default applies. First consumer: waveform settings (section waveform, PR2.3); the pattern is mandatory for future per-file settings (req 2).

steps.title: Идентичность и раскладка: slug+hash8, resolve папки, ProjectStoreError
steps.verify: bun test project-store (Windows paths, case-insensitivity, cyrillic/forbidden chars, long names)
evidence: project-store.ts: normalizeSourcePath (400 on empty), projectIdentityKey = resolve().toLowerCase() (same normalization as the editor-store write locks), sha1 hash8, projectSlug, projectDirName = <slug>-<hash8>, resolveProjectDir = <root>/projects/<dirName>; layout constants PROJECT_FILE_NAME / UNDO_FILE_NAME / PROJECTS_DIR_NAME / PROJECT_KIND.

Slug is lowercased like the identity key: the first test run caught that a case-preserving slug made the folder name depend on the casing a path arrived with (hash matched, name did not -- two dirs for one file on POSIX).

Sanitization checks char codes instead of an escape-range regex: a u0000-u001f regex literal embedded real control bytes into the file and re-created the server.ts NUL trap (caught and rewritten during this step; verified 0 control bytes in the final file).

bun test project-store: 7 pass / 13 expect (case-insensitive identity; same basename in different dirs differs; cyrillic kept; forbidden chars replaced; 40-char cap; degenerate names fall back; 400 on empty path).

steps.title: Хранилище project.scp.json: атомарная запись, толерантное чтение, unknown sections, очередь записи
steps.verify: bun test project-store (tmp+rename; corrupt file -> .broken-<ts> + empty restart; unknown sections survive rewrite; concurrent puts serialized)
evidence: ProjectFileData { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'SoundCoreProject', source fingerprint, createdAt/updatedAt, sections } with an index signature so unknown top-level fields AND unknown sections written by a future version survive a rewrite (tested: hand-crafted file with futureTopLevel + fromFutureSubsystem section round-trips intact).

writeProjectFile: mkdir -p, pretty JSON + trailing newline into .project.scp.json.tmp-<uuid>, rename over, temp cleaned in finally (tested: no .tmp- leftovers). readProjectFile: missing -> null with no side effects; corrupt JSON or foreign shape (e.g. schemaVersion 99) -> renamed to project.scp.json.broken-<ts> with original bytes preserved + console.error, then null.

SerialQueues: withFileLock pattern generalized by key -- same key strictly sequential, different keys interleave, a rejected action does not poison the queue (all three asserted in one test with explicit gates).
bun test project-store: 13 pass / 33 expect.

steps.title: Полный API ядра: open/list/get, секции, undo-транспорт, delete, relink
steps.verify: bun test project-store (find-or-create; source.path scan fallback when the hash dir does not match; section round-trip; undo limits; delete guarded to projects/; relink updates source + folder stays)
evidence: interface ProjectStore + ProjectStoreImpl + createProjectStore({resolveUserDataRoot}) -- root resolved per operation (a runtime settings change needs no restart); store is stateless between calls (every op reads scp.json inside the per-project SerialQueues lane), so there is no cache to go stale.

openProject: fingerprint (404 when the source is missing/not a file) -> locateProject (hash dir first, then a source.path identity scan so a relinked project whose folder is named after the OLD path is still found) -> queued find-or-create; a case-only path variation neither duplicates the project nor rewrites the stored pretty path; fingerprint refresh writes only when size/mtime/path actually changed.

Sections: get/putSection with name validation (400), null value deletes the section; undo: get/putUndoJournal in a wrapped {schemaVersion, updatedAt, journal} undo.json, null clears, >5MB -> 413 (UNDO_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES); deleteProject: isSafeProjectId (400) + inside-projects guard (403) + 404 when absent; relinkProject keeps id/folder and swaps the source fingerprint.
listProjects reads with recover=false so listing never renames other projects' broken files (asserted: bytes untouched), sorts by updatedAt desc; getProject reports sourceStatus ok|missing.

bun test project-store: 21 pass / 68 expect. Server typecheck via bun x tsc@5.7.3 --ignoreDeprecations 5.0 (bunx pitfall from [[verify-typecheck-workflow]]): only the known pre-existing audio-cache-manifest.ts TS2540.

steps.title: UI-клиент project-api.ts + composable use-project.ts + openProject из потока выбора файла
steps.verify: bun run typecheck + bun run build (MindWaveCore/ui); bun test ui server (GnauralCore); manual: opening a .gnaural creates the project folder with project.scp.json
evidence: project-api.ts: requestJson wrapper mirrored from audio-api.ts; openProject/fetchProjects/fetchProject/fetchSection/putSection/fetchUndoJournal/putUndoJournal/relinkProject/deleteProject; putSection and putUndoJournal use keepalive:true so the unload-time flush still lands.

composables/use-project.ts: module-singleton currentProject; openProjectForFile flushes the previous file's pending writes first and never throws (a project failure must not break file opening -- error kept in projectOpenError); readProjectSection short-circuits to a pending debounced value; writeProjectSection debounces 500ms per section (last-write-wins, PR-D7); beforeunload flush.
stores/audio.ts: selectPath and selectExternalPath call openProjectForFile (deselect -> closeCurrentProject) -- every opened file, wav/flac/gnaural alike, gets its project.
Verify: vue-tsc clean; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui server 252 pass / 850 expect.

Live smoke against the real server (bun run server.ts --ui-only --port=3417, LOCALAPPDATA redirected to a scratch dir): POST /api/projects/open for 'Smoke Тест.gnaural' -> id smoke_тест-9afabf60, sourceStatus ok; project.scp.json provisioned under <LOCALAPPDATA>/KKSoundCore/projects/<id>/; section round-trip zoom=2.5; list count=1. log.text: Phase 1 (the priority: service class + API) complete in one session -- PR1.1..PR1.5 done, each with its own commit and green verify (project-store bun tests 22, GnauralCore ui+server 252, vue-tsc, quasar build, tsc@5.7.3 server typecheck). End-to-end smoke on the real server: opening a file provisions <LOCALAPPDATA>/KKSoundCore/projects/<slug>-<hash8>/project.scp.json and sections round-trip over REST. Stopped at the PR1.6 PAUSE for the owner to click through the live app and approve naming/layout/sections before Phase 2 integrations.

PR0.2 PAUSE passed -- owner answered Q1-Q5: (1) userDataRoot default = %LOCALAPPDATA%\KKSoundCore; (2) move everything out of the .gnaural file -- voice colour/hidden/muted become the voiceState project section, new step PR2.4, the old PAUSE renumbered to PR2.5; (3) text export bundle approved; (4) caches stay CENTRAL (UI must always see them) -- cache API removed from the core, PR6.1 retargeted to the central manifest, PR6.2 dropped; (5) waveform settings become project-owned overrides on top of editor defaults -- new decision PR-D13. Plan reqs 8-12 added; decisions PR-D3/D5/D6/D9/D10/D11 revised. Phase 1 (service class + API) starts.

Plan + ledger created for the Project entity (owner req. 2026-07-15): per-file editor data -- curve colours, waves, undo journal -- moves into a per-project folder under a configurable user-data root; main file project.scp.json, everything text except bin under cache/; cache data lives in the project folder too. Survey found today's state scattered: voice colours are written INTO the .gnaural, lanes/solo live in per-file localStorage keys, undo and zoom are memory-only and lost on reload, caches are central under server/tmp. Full function set planned (open/sections/undo/cache/list/relink/delete/import/export/settings), with the service class + API first (PR-D5, Phase 1). Decisions PR-D1..D12 proposed; five owner questions (default data folder, fate of in-file voice colours, export format, render-cache move, per-file waveform colours) queued at the PR0.2 PAUSE.
